title: Engine Fuel and Control — Re-Route Channel B of the Electronic Control Harness and Install Fire-Rated Sleeving

ata.title: Engine Fuel Control — Electronic Control Unit

abstract: Separates the two channels of the engine electronic control harness onto opposite sides of the fan case and re-sleeves both in fire-rated material, closing a common-mode exposure found during a zonal safety re-assessment.

sections.planning_reason: A zonal safety re-assessment of the fan case found both channels of the engine electronic control harness running in the same bundle over a 900 mm length at the four o'clock position, inside the fire zone and adjacent to a fuel line flange. A single fire or a single chafe event could affect both channels. No in-service event has occurred and the original installation was accepted, but the arrangement is not defensible against the current interpretation of the segregation requirement.
sections.description: This Service Bulletin gives the instructions to re-route channel B of the engine electronic control harness from the four o'clock to the eight o'clock position on the fan case, to install six new support brackets on the left side, to replace the existing clamps with the fire-rated equivalent and to re-sleeve both channels over the section inside the designated fire zone. The connector backshells are renewed at both control unit connectors because the sleeving increases the bundle diameter. The control unit itself and its software are unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the fan cowl doors and unlatch the core cowl. Disconnect both channels at the control unit using AMM-T-73-20-11-000-001-A and cap the connectors. Release channel B from its existing clamps and lay it clear. Install the six support brackets on the left side of the fan case at the positions given in the installation drawing, using the drilling template supplied. Fit the fire-rated sleeving over both channels for the length inside the fire zone. Route channel B to the eight o'clock position through the new brackets, using the fire-rated clamps at every position, and confirm the minimum separation from channel A along the whole run. Renew the connector backshells and reconnect both channels using AMM-T-73-20-11-400-001-A. Change the harness identification to the new route standard. Do the control unit built-in test and the engine ground run called out in the installation task. Close the cowls. Record the modification.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to CVX-7270 powered TTN-88E1 aircraft in the MSN T00090 to T00232 range. Auran powered aircraft carry a different fan case with the channels already separated and are outside this effectivity. Engines are converted individually and mixed standards are acceptable in service, but the engine change documentation must state the routing standard.
sections.material_note: Kit K7320-1012-01 covers one engine. Order four kits per aircraft. The fire-rated sleeving is supplied cut to length and must not be spliced. Removed clamps are scrapped locally. There is no long-lead item.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next engine shop visit, or within 48 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
